clips.text: With your model connected, open Export Actions. Use Search exports to find a prepared export, select it, then choose Run Selected Exports. This example uses a fictional Revenue Summary.
Review the destination warning. Existing destination data and formulas can be replaced. Choose Confirm exports only when the destination is correct, or Cancel to leave the workbook unchanged.
After confirming, review the exported report in its destination tab. Our fictional Revenue Summary shows a total budget of one hundred twenty million dollars. Next, we will export a saved view.
For a saved view, open Saved Views, find the relevant module, and select the view you want. Choose Export View to continue. Here, we select Operating Results from the Financial Planning module.
The saved view also requires a destination review. Existing destination data and formulas can be replaced. Choose Confirm export to proceed, or Cancel to keep the workbook unchanged.

Review the saved-view result in its destination tab. You have now seen both export paths: prepared Export Actions and Saved Views. Continue to refresh and scheduling to learn how to update connected reports.
